subject: EverWave vendor onboarding and payment terms discussion
messages:
From: Kayla Peterson <kayla.peterson@everwave.com>
To: jasmine_liu@redwood.com
Date: 2026-06-28T10:05:00-07:00
Subject: New vendor onboarding — EverWave (payment terms)

Hi Jasmine,

Thanks for taking the meeting yesterday. Attached is our completed vendor onboarding packet and the preliminary billing cadence we typically use. Our standard account terms are Net 45; we can invoice monthly. We also have an early-pay program (dynamic discounting) — we can offer 1.5% if paid within 15 days, or 0.5% within 30 days.

Can Redwood confirm whether Net 45 is acceptable and whether you can support early-pay enrollment so we can submit invoices into your portal? If needed, I can provide bank details and a W-9; attaching the onboarding_form.pdf for now.

Thanks — Kayla
Kayla Peterson
Head of Strategic Accounts, EverWave Analytics
attachments: onboarding_form.pdf (form, 2 pages)

From: Jasmine Liu <jasmine_liu@redwood.com>
To: Kayla Peterson <kayla.peterson@everwave.com>
Cc: priyom_das@redwood.com, vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com, laura_bennett@redwood.com
Date: 2026-06-28T11:12:00-07:00
Subject: Re: New vendor onboarding — EverWave (payment terms)

Hi Kayla — great to meet you yesterday.

Quick notes: Redwood's standard vendor terms are Net 30 but we do approve Net 45 on a case-by-case basis for strategic suppliers. To get this through AP we need: a completed W-9, bank remit form (for ACH), and a signed vendor agreement (DocuSign). I put the items we need in the attached checklist and included a DocuSign link for the vendor agreement.

If you'd like early-pay enrollment, finance will assess and (if approved) it will be handled through our Dynamic Discounting program — rates are evaluated against cashflow and vendor priority. Please attach the W-9 and bank_remit.pdf and confirm the exact early-pay discount you'd like to offer (you mentioned 1.5% / 15 days).

Next steps:
- You send W-9 + bank details (reply to this thread)
- I'll route to Finance (Vivek) and Procurement (Laura/Priyom) for Net45 + early-pay approval
- If approved, Procurement will create the supplier record and Finance will provide enrollment steps for early-pay portal

DocuSign: https://www.docusign.net/embeddedSigning/ABC1234

Best,
Jasmine Liu
Sr. Strategic Accounts Manager — Redwood Inference
attachments: vendor_onboarding_checklist.pdf (1 page)

From: Kayla Peterson <kayla.peterson@everwave.com>
To: Jasmine Liu <jasmine_liu@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-06-29T09:30:00-07:00
Subject: Re: New vendor onboarding — EverWave (payment terms)

Thanks, Jasmine — attaching the remaining docs (W-9_EverWave.pdf, bank_remit.pdf) and a short spreadsheet (early_pay_proposal.xlsx) that outlines the discount tiers and preferred remit instructions.

Confirming: we prefer Net 45 and request enrollment in your dynamic discount program at 1.25% for payment within 15 days (we are flexible — can accept 1.5% if necessary). We typically invoice on the 1st business day of each month for the prior month.

Also: our legal team has a short addendum about PO references on invoices — they ask that Redwood include the PO number on each invoice line item. Happy to sign any DocuSign items.

Best,
Kayla
attachments: W-9_EverWave.pdf; bank_remit.pdf; early_pay_proposal.xlsx

Date: 2026-06-29T10:00:00-07:00
Subject: Fwd: EverWave onboarding docs — Net45 + early-pay request

Forwarding EverWave's docs. Key ask: approve Net 45 and enroll vendor in Dynamic Discounting at 1.25% / 15 days (Kayla offered up to 1.5% but prefers 1.25%).

Context: EverWave is a mid-market analytics vendor we want live before their integration kickoff (target July 12). If we approve Net 45 it avoids customers getting invoices misaligned with their month ends; procurement note: vendor requests PO references on each invoice line which is standard for us.

Questions for Finance/Procurement:
- Vivek: any objections on Net 45 for a new supplier? Impact to cash forecasting (approx $120k ARR initial footprint).
- Laura/Priyom: can you create supplier record and a monthly consolidated PO model (so they invoice monthly against one PO)?

I can get Kayla to sign the DocuSign immediately once we confirm.

Date: 2026-06-29T13:20:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: EverWave onboarding docs — Net45 + early-pay request

Thanks for the context — approve Net 45 for EverWave. Finance is OK to support enrollment in Dynamic Discounting at the proposed 1.25% / 15 days. A couple notes:
- We will need the W-9 and bank information (received) to complete supplier setup.
- Please confirm whether invoices will reference a single monthly PO or line-item POs. Finance prefers a single consolidated monthly PO to reduce PO churn; that works for EverWave per Kayla's note.
- Once Procurement confirms the supplier record, Finance will send enrollment steps and the payment portal invitation (expect 2 business days).

Laura / Priyom: please create the supplier record with Net 45 terms, note "Early-pay eligible: yes (1.25% @15 days)" in the supplier notes, and set default remit to ACH. Once done, notify Finance so we can issue the portal invite.

Vivek
VP, Finance — Redwood Inference
